g.text: Title: Minimum core - independent power and local reset

g.desc: Title: Minimum core - independent power and local reset

g.text: HARDWARE REVIEW DRAFT - NOT RELEASED FOR PCB

g.desc: HARDWARE REVIEW DRAFT - NOT RELEASED FOR PCB

g.text: CONTROLLER | local regulated 5 V input | independent 3.3 V | common ground

g.desc: CONTROLLER | local regulated 5 V input | independent 3.3 V | common ground

g.style: fill:#FFFFC2; fill-opacity:1.0000; stroke:none;

g.style: fill:#FFFFC2; fill-opacity:1.0000; stroke:none;

g.text: 5 V INPUT / INDEPENDENT 3.3 V MCU RAIL

g.desc: 5 V INPUT / INDEPENDENT 3.3 V MCU RAIL

g.text: Regulated baseboard supply: +5V_CORE_IN = 4.75-5.25 V at header. Shared GND; no galvanic isolation.

g.desc: Regulated baseboard supply: +5V_CORE_IN = 4.75-5.25 V at header. Shared GND; no galvanic isolation.

g.text: 100 mA continuous core budget; optional CAN/sensors require a fresh load and thermal budget.

g.desc: 100 mA continuous core budget; optional CAN/sensors require a fresh load and thermal budget.

g.text: RESET is open drain; CT open gives nominal 20 ms release delay.

g.desc: RESET is open drain; CT open gives nominal 20 ms release delay.

g.text: MR divider requires 5 V presence even if ADC clamps back-power 3.3 V.

g.desc: MR divider requires 5 V presence even if ADC clamps back-power 3.3 V.

g.text: RESET and C81 stay on the core support page; SWD is on the base.

g.desc: RESET and C81 stay on the core support page; SWD is on the base.

g.text: CORE_RESET_OK goes to the separate RUN_ARM gate.

g.desc: CORE_RESET_OK goes to the separate RUN_ARM gate.

g.text: PC7/RUN_ARM is required before CTRL_READY can be HIGH.

g.desc: PC7/RUN_ARM is required before CTRL_READY can be HIGH.

g.text: U101 SNS (pin 2) connects to OUT, GND pins 3/5 and EP7 to GND.

g.desc: U101 SNS (pin 2) connects to OUT, GND pins 3/5 and EP7 to GND.

g.text: Input/output capacitors and EP thermal copper stay on the core.

g.desc: Input/output capacitors and EP thermal copper stay on the core.

g.text: The 1 A IC rating does not increase the header/core 100 mA budget.

g.desc: The 1 A IC rating does not increase the header/core 100 mA budget.

g.text: ADC CLAMP-CURRENT ABSORBER / LOCAL 3.3 V BULK

g.desc: ADC CLAMP-CURRENT ABSORBER / LOCAL 3.3 V BULK

g.text: Nominal clamp: 2.495 x (1 + 3.83k/10k) + IREF x 3.83k ~ 3.46 V.

g.desc: Nominal clamp: 2.495 x (1 + 3.83k/10k) + IREF x 3.83k ~ 3.46 V.

g.text: Positive transient injection budget <=50 mA; no hard current limit.

g.desc: Positive transient injection budget <=50 mA; no hard current limit.

g.text: Inputs 5.25 V, rail >=3.25 V, zero diode Vf, resistors -1%: total 48.93 mA.

g.desc: Inputs 5.25 V, rail >=3.25 V, zero diode Vf, resistors -1%: total 48.93 mA.

g.text: The downstream 100R does not limit rail injection.

g.desc: The downstream 100R does not limit rail injection.

g.text: ADC RC: (360+100)R x 1nF = 0.46 us; add external source impedance.

g.desc: ADC RC: (360+100)R x 1nF = 0.46 us; add external source impedance.

g.text: C305 required for shunt stability; validate startup/pulse/ringing on prototype.

g.desc: C305 required for shunt stability; validate startup/pulse/ringing on prototype.

g.text: No sustained 60 V fault immunity is claimed.

g.desc: No sustained 60 V fault immunity is claimed.

g.text: D102 prevents output/injection current returning to the 5 V header.

g.desc: D102 prevents output/injection current returning to the 5 V header.

g.text: D103 bypasses LDO reverse stress when OUT remains charged.

g.desc: D103 bypasses LDO reverse stress when OUT remains charged.

g.text: TVS clamp is 10.3 V at its specified pulse: U101 accepts up to 16 V.

g.desc: TVS clamp is 10.3 V at its specified pulse: U101 accepts up to 16 V.

g.text: No sustained 24/60 V miswire or IEC surge qualification is claimed.

g.desc: No sustained 24/60 V miswire or IEC surge qualification is claimed.
